Hmm, wait — maybe the arrow keys do move the brush, but the brush can't move down because the white box is blocking it? The gap between the bottom of the purple frame (row 32) and the top of the white box (row 34) is 1 row (row 33). If the brush moves down one cell, the frame would be at rows 25-33, still not overlapping the white box at row 34. So it should have been able to move. Unless movement is blocked by adjacency?
